exposure: letrozole co-treatment in an antagonist protocol
outcome: live birth rate after fresh embryo transfer

cohort: Overweight infertile women undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment and fresh embryo transfer.
finding: Letrozole co-treatment in an antagonist protocol was associated with a significantly higher live birth rate after fresh embryo transfer in overweight infertile women.
